title: PRD writer skill: write, regenerate and feedback, codes, [no source], audit appendix, versions, sections without decisions
story: Grillo now ships a PRD writer skill beside the grilling engine. When the map is done it writes the next numbered, dated PRD version, with source codes on every decision, [no source] marks and an audit appendix. A PRD section with nothing decided gets a ticket or a fog line instead of being written. Regenerate writes a new version on demand, and talking to an agent about the PRD turns feedback into edits or tickets. Before this, nothing wrote the PRD after the map-done rule fired.

checks.criterion: Writes prd/v<n>.md with codes, [no source] marks and the audit appendix, and never overwrites an earlier version
checks.steps: Make a made-up test repository whose map is done and whose .grillo/prd/v1.md already exists. Copy resources/skills/grillo-prd/ and resources/skills/grillo-wayfinder/ into .claude/skills/. Run claude there and type /grillo-prd.
checks.expected: A new .grillo/prd/v2.md on main, with v1 unchanged. Every statement ends with [S.., Q..] or [no source]. The appendix lists every cited code with who, when, where and the exact words, and every [no source] statement sits under Unsourced.

checks.criterion: A structure section with no decision is not written
checks.steps: In the same test repository, add a section Costs to .grillo/structure.json and push it. Type /grillo-prd regenerate.
checks.expected: No new version file, plus a new ticket or a fog line starting 'Costs: ', and the agent saying the map is not done.

checks.criterion: Feedback edits the PRD or opens tickets, and the PRD is written again when those close
checks.steps: Type /grillo-prd feedback. Ask for one wording fix. Confirm one [no source] statement and answer its ticket in the same chat.
checks.expected: One new version holding only the wording edit, then a Confirm: ticket opened, answered and closed, then a further version that cites the new answer's codes.
